title: UN Charter takes effect
body:
The United Nations Charter took effect once the five permanent Security Council members and most other signers had ratified it.

Fifty nations signed it in San Francisco that June. October 24 is still marked as United Nations Day.
photoNote: Wartime poster quoting the Charter's opening words. NARA 516086, public domain. This one is a poster, not a photo; frame it so the words show.
